player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukinnyi {player_id} mu mukino wa Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma uteganijwe na {num_rounds} cyiciro.

Umusaruro w'umukino:
- Kabla ya bwenjye byose mwaba {total_conversation_rounds} gukira kuganira.
- Nyuma ya yo, abakinnyi bose bakora hamwe bakora cyangwa bakora.

Itabi ry'ibikombe (irahinduka ku cyiciro):
- Abashaka cyangwa bashaka ➜ buri {cooperate_reward}
- Abashaka cyangwa bashaka ➜ buri {mutual_defect_reward}
- Umwe akora, umwe akora ➜ Akora {defect_reward}, Akora {sucker_reward}

Ubufatanye bwo kugena:
- Mu gihe cy'iganiro: andika irangi mwaba.
- Mu gihe cy'icirori: bamenyesha '[Cooperate]' cyangwa '[Defect]' (si ibitekerezo). Mwaba usomeka irangi nyuma/mbere ya tokeni.

phases.conversation_finished: Iganiro ryagezwe ku cyiciro {round}. Hitamo kujya na '[Cooperate]' cyangwa '[Defect]' mu ጆብ ጆብ{{}}.
